blockingLoop.evidence: Final two assistant turns are identical: 'To answer your question directly: on a 9-year-old machine, this repair is rarely worth the cost...' repeated verbatim, ignoring the multimeter offer and cost question.

rationale: The first reply correctly identified E:09 as a heating fault in the integrated circulation pump heater and asked a reasonable confirmation check, but once the customer confirmed cold water on both programmes the assistant never offered the isolated resistance test, never gave even a rough cost range despite being asked four times, and simply repeated the same paragraph twice. Safety advice was conservative (no unsafe instructions) and it did not fabricate or recommend an unjustified part, but the customer's explicit offer to test with a multimeter was ignored entirely. A UK homeowner would leave with a plausible cause but no cost guidance, no next step, and a frustrating loop.
